acceptanceCriteria: A CI job runs make gate-affected-test (sh and dash) on linux; AFP-V0-016 consent recorded for the .github change.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1399/1400/1401 lane (PR #922, BASE d47b0f01e). The gate-affected wrapper test (TERM/descendant kill, /proc fallback, dash) is a make target only; no workflow runs it, so regressions in script/gate-affected-corvint.sh are caught only by hand.
title: ci: gate-affected-test (script/gate-affected-corvint_test.sh) runs only as a Makefile target, never in CI
